1/S0.subgoal: Identify common questions beginners have about XR terms and explain the general interest in the field.

1/S1.subgoal: Describe various popular perceptions of AR, VR, and MR experiences, such as movies, games, and medical visualizations.

1/S2.subgoal: Explain the definitions of XR, AR, VR, and MR and the concept of immersive technology.

1/S3.subgoal: Describe the reality-virtuality continuum and how it distinguishes between augmented reality and augmented virtuality.

1/S4.subgoal: Explain the commercial, industrial, and career significance of XR technologies.

1/S5.subgoal: Summarize the main points of the lecture.
